content: bubblewrap on Ubuntu 24.04+: kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=1 breaks unprivileged bwrap (Failed to fully mount capsicum); fixes are per-app AppArmor profile with flags=(unconfined) userns, sysctl disable, or bubblewrap 0.11+ on 24.10+. Docker hosts inherit the restriction. This fragility is why Codex CLI moved to Landlock+seccomp as the native Linux path (kernel>=5.13, no namespaces needed) with Docker fallback.
